class.name: SceneryStreamingServer
class.brief_description: Builds scenery content only where the camera is.
class.description: A real scenery places hundreds of thousands of pieces - models, merged terrain meshes, tracks, traction spans - and building them all while loading costs both the loading time and the frame rate, because most of them are nowhere near the camera. A rendering server registers itself as an owner with [method owner_create] and then registers each of its pieces with [method stream_register], saying where it is and how far it is meant to be visible. The piece is built once the camera set with [method set_camera] comes within that range of the 1[code] [/code]km chunk holding it, and cleared again when the camera leaves. Pieces that declare no range of their own are streamed up to [method get_draw_distance] ([code]maszyna/rendering/scenery_draw_distance[/code]). Planning runs on a worker thread, together with whatever an owner wants prepared off the main thread (the [code]preload[/code] callable - loading a model, building a mesh). Building and clearing run on the main thread within a per-frame time budget, because they touch [RenderingServer] and GDScript. Owners: [E3DRenderingServer] (scenery models), [code]SceneryChunkRenderingServer[/code] (merged terrain meshes), [code]TrackRenderingServer[/code] and [code]TractionRenderingServer[/code].

method.name: get_draw_distance
method.description: Range used for pieces registered with a [code]range_end[/code] of [code]0[/code], read from [code]maszyna/rendering/scenery_draw_distance[/code] at startup.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: What the streaming is doing right now, shown by the "Scenery Streaming" debug window ([code]res://hud/scenery_streaming_panel.gd[/code]): [code]owners[/code], [code]registered[/code], [code]streamed[/code], [code]chunks[/code], [code]active_chunks[/code], [code]pending_builds[/code], [code]pending_clears[/code], [code]build_rate[/code] (builds applied in the last second), [code]budget_msec[/code] (the per-frame budget in use), [code]plan_msec[/code] (duration of the last planning pass), [code]draw_distance[/code], [code]chunk_size[/code], [code]camera_position[/code], [code]camera_chunk[/code] and [code]has_camera[/code].

method.name: get_streamed_count
method.description: Pieces currently streamed in - what the streaming actually keeps built.

method.name: owner_create
method.description: Registers a rendering server with the streaming and returns its owner id, to be passed to [method stream_register]. [param preload] is called as [code]preload(rid: RID) -> Variant[/code] on the worker thread and its result is handed to [param build]; pass an empty [Callable] when there is nothing to prepare off the main thread. [param build] is called as [code]build(rid: RID, preloaded: Variant)[/code] and [param clear] as [code]clear(rid: RID)[/code], both on the main thread, within the per-frame budget.

method.name: set_camera
method.description: Camera the streaming follows; without one nothing is ever built. Passing [code]null[/code] stops the streaming, leaving whatever is built in place. In game this is the player's camera, in the editor the camera of the 3D view.

method.name: stream_free
method.description: Unregisters a piece. The owner's [code]clear[/code] callable is not called - whoever frees the piece frees its content too.

method.name: stream_register
method.description: Registers one piece of an owner, placed at [param position] and visible up to [param range_end] ([code]0[/code] - up to [method get_draw_distance]). [param rid] is the owner's own handle for the piece and is what the owner's callables receive. Returns the handle for [method stream_free].
